scope: Two original-client SRT diagnostic journeys, not complete subtitle playback acceptance

fixture.boundary: Read-only private receipt and Linux process pins; no HTTP, database, or client acceptance claim

capture_policy.allocation_boundary: Playwright may buffer the complete decoded response before the byte check. Limits bound parsing and retained projections, not transport allocation.

contract.initial_selection_policy: Record actual native modes and visible synthetic cues; do not infer an initial Off selection.

srt_action_window.boundary: Playwright click invocation and completion; requests and responses retain their original receipt times

policy.token_source: Exact observed logout request headers or query fields, retained only in memory
policy.token_fingerprint: SHA-256 of the decoded observed token
policy.browser_context_requirement: Fresh context, no storageState, attached before first page
policy.metadata_policy: Only observed authorization and allowlisted Emby client metadata are replayed
